game_name: Mega Man: The Power Battle (CPS2, USA 950925, SAMPLE Version)
general_issues: Select mmancp2ur2.zip; keep parent archives, keys and required qsound.zip beside it. Experimental emulation; profile coverage does not mean full gameplay qualification. TPO automatically assigns up to 2 computers. Each computer controls one player on the shared cabinet using its Player 1 controls. Offline EEPROM and manual cabinet settings are ignored during online play.
